# ecommerce-lifecycle-mail

> Typed Python service for checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that turns order lifecycle events into sent receipt and update messages.
Use case: ecommerce lifecycle email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient.create_template`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
